When we look into the living reality of this teaching, the master points out with unwavering clarity: *"So we often times want to have experiences, interesting experiences because silence is not interesting. [snorts] [clears throat] So ultimate reality is not interesting or exciting."* From the foundational perspective of the Four Noble Truths, suffering (*dukkha*) is never caused by the mere presence of sensations, thoughts, or external conditions.
